review.imagery: Twenty-seven own-project renders were visually reviewed. Twenty-four native brochure scenes and three distinct current-gallery angles cover the whole tower, roof, aerial, pool, family/leisure spaces, lobby, home interiors, gym and spa. Leaf backgrounds, generic people photos, an unpainted isolated building layer and repeated gallery crops are excluded. The complete daylight exterior supplies the card and hero. Fitout and views remain proposed and unit-unspecific.
review.floorPlans: Three complete home drawings come from the official brochure. Three building sheets come from an Immobilie Dubai broker mirror of the SAMANA-branded floorplate pack. The first-floor gym, typical floors and floor-14 footprint remain separate. Numerical unit areas and approved matching between generic home drawings and numbered units are unavailable. Confirm the selected unit and contractual area with SAMANA. All three official home sheets on physical pages 41–43 and all three mirror floorplates on pages 2–4 were visually reviewed. Exact unit keys, original legends, source notices and entire floor footprints remain visible. No drawing-specific numerical area is inferred from a generic category minimum.
review.location: Complete original brochure travel panel page 9 and regional map page 10 were visually reviewed. Global Village and Dubai Mall/Miracle Garden range conflicts remain explicit. The primary name-only map query is saved with source hash. No coordinate, live route, road distance or operational transport claim is invented.
review.provenance: Primary HTML and original official brochure retain receipts, hashes and native image origins. Additional research found the publicly accessible SAMANA-branded floorplate pack at a German broker mirror. Its original bytes and attribution are preserved separately. Complete drawing sheets and physical PDF links remain available. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: Drawing-specific numerical unit areas, approved home-to-unit matching, final fitout, verified visitor entrance coordinates and dated construction photographs were not established.
